claim.claim-text: 1. An operation method of user equipment (UE), comprising: if the UE is using an Evolved Packet System (EPS) service with control plane Cellular Internet of Things (CIoT) EPS optimization with overhead reduction, generating an EPS Mobility Management (EMM) transport message, wherein the EMM transport message includes a protocol discriminator, a security header type, a message authentication code and a sequence number, wherein if the EMM transport message is sent in an EMM data transport procedure or if the EMM transport message is sent in a service request procedure for UE using the EPS service with control plane CIOT EPS optimization with overhead reduction to send a user data, a short message service (SMS) message or a location service (LCS) message, the EMM transport message further includes a data container, wherein if the data container is included in the EMM transport message, the EMM transport message is transmitted partially ciphered by using a ciphering algorithm, wherein input parameters to the ciphering algorithm includes a length of a key stream to be generated by an encryption algorithm, and wherein for the EMM transport message, the length of the key stream is set to a length of a portion of the EMM transport message starting with octet 7 until an end of the EMM transport message.
2. The method of claim 1, further comprising: transmitting the EMM transport message as integrity protected.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the data container is deciphered using a ciphering algorithm of a current EPS security context.
4. The method of claim 1, wherein the data container contains a data payload and control information associated with the data payload.

5. A user equipment (UE), the UE comprising: at least one processor; and at least one computer memory operably connectable to the at least one processor and storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, perform operations comprising: if the UE is using an Evolved Packet System (EPS) service with control plane Cellular Internet of Things (CIoT) EPS optimization with overhead reduction, generating an EPS Mobility Management (EMM) transport message, wherein the EMM transport message includes a protocol discriminator, a security header type, a message authentication code and a sequence number, wherein if the EMM transport message is sent in an EMM data transport procedure or if the EMM transport message is sent in a service request procedure for UE using the EPS service with control plane CIOT EPS optimization with overhead reduction to send a user data, a short message service (SMS) message or a location service (LCS) message, the EMM transport message further includes a data container, wherein if the data container is included in the EMM transport message, the EMM transport message is transmitted partially ciphered by using a ciphering algorithm, wherein input parameters to the ciphering algorithm includes a length of a key stream to be generated by an encryption algorithm, and wherein for the EMM transport message, the length of the key stream is set to a length of a portion of the EMM transport message starting with octet 7 until an end of the EMM transport message.
6. The UE of claim 5, wherein the operations further include: transmitting the EMM transport message as integrity protected.
7. The UE of claim 5, wherein the data container is deciphered using a ciphering algorithm of a current EPS security context.
8. The UE of claim 5, wherein the data container contains a data payload and control information associated with the data payload.

9. A semiconductor chipset for a user equipment (UE), comprising: at least one processor; and at least one memory capable of storing instructions and being connected electrically to the at least one processor operably, wherein operations, performed when the instructions are executed by the at least one processor, includes: if the UE is using an Evolved Packet System (EPS) service with control plane Cellular Internet of Things (CIoT) EPS optimization with overhead reduction, generating an EPS Mobility Management (EMM) transport message, wherein the EMM transport message includes a protocol discriminator, a security header type, a message authentication code and a sequence number, wherein if the EMM transport message is sent in an EMM data transport procedure or if the EMM transport message is sent in a service request procedure for UE using the EPS service with control plane CIOT EPS optimization with overhead reduction to send a user data, a short message service (SMS) message or a location service (LCS) message, the EMM transport message further includes a data container, wherein if the data container is included in the EMM transport message, the EMM transport message is transmitted partially ciphered by using a ciphering algorithm, wherein input parameters to the ciphering algorithm includes a length of a key stream to be generated by an encryption algorithm, and wherein for the EMM transport message, the length of the key stream is set to a length of a portion of the EMM transport message starting with octet 7 until an end of the EMM transport message.
10. The semiconductor chipset of claim 9, wherein the operations further include: transmitting the EMM transport message as integrity protected.
11. The semiconductor chipset of claim 9, wherein the data container is deciphered using a ciphering algorithm of a current EPS security context.
12. The semiconductor chipset of claim 9, wherein the data container contains a data payload and control information associated with the data payload.
